text: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. is Tokyo- and NYSE-listed. Per its FY2026 Form 20-F, Honda states it 'is not directly or indirectly owned or controlled by any other corporation, by any government, or by any other natural or legal person'; its disclosed 5%+ holders are trust-bank nominees The Master Trust Bank of Japan (17.5%) and Custody Bank of Japan (7.1%), ADS nominee Moxley & Co. (5.7%), and BlackRock (6.1%, per a separate Schedule 13G).

source.name: Honda Motor Co., Ltd. Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (SEC EDGAR)
source.quote: To the knowledge of Honda, it is not directly or indirectly owned or controlled by any other corporation, by any government, or by any other natural or legal person
